#!/bin/sh
if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'direct archive "Electronic Archive" "Electronic Archive File Sink"'
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$#" -lt 5 ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: invalid CUPS backend invocation' >&2
  exit 1
fi
job_id=$1
title=$3
options=$5
input=${6-}
dest=${DEVICE_URI#archive:}
case "$dest" in
  /*) ;;
  *) printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: archive URI must contain an absolute directory' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
archive_id=
for option in $options; do
  case "$option" in
    archive-job-id=*) archive_id=${option#archive-job-id=} ;;
  esac
done
if [ -z "$archive_id" ]; then
  archive_id=job-$job_id
fi
case "$archive_id" in
  .|..|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*) printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: unsafe archive job identifier' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
if [ ! -d "$dest" ]; then
  printf 'ERROR: archive directory missing: %s\n' "$dest" >&2
  exit 1
fi
tmp=$(mktemp "$dest/.archive-${job_id}.XXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
if [ -n "$input" ]; then
  cat -- "$input" > "$tmp" || exit 1
else
  cat > "$tmp" || exit 1
fi
target=$dest/$archive_id.prn
if ln "$tmp" "$target" 2>/dev/null; then
  chmod 0644 "$target" || exit 1
  rm -f "$tmp"
  trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
  printf 'INFO: archived job %s (%s) as %s\n' "$job_id" "$title" "$target" >&2
  exit 0
fi
if [ -f "$target" ] && cmp -s "$tmp" "$target"; then
  printf 'INFO: identical job already archived as %s\n' "$target" >&2
  exit 0
fi
printf 'ERROR: refusing to overwrite existing archive %s\n' "$target" >&2
exit 1
